anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals (10, 10.14, 10.3) for an 8-core system, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, opportunities, or adjustments, which may indicate a malfunction or misconfiguration.
Trading system is not executing any trades or generating profit/loss, which is unusual for an active trading platform.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize the CPU usage to reduce load average and prevent potential system slowdowns or failures.
Review and potentially reconfigure AI learning parameters to ensure it is actively generating opportunities and making adjustments.
Evaluate the trading strategies and system configuration to ensure they are correctly set up and capable of executing trades.

recommendations.action: Immediately investigate the high CPU load to identify and resolve any processes or configurations causing excessive load.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability, slow performance, and potential downtime, which is critical for a trading platform.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough review of the AI system's configuration and logs to diagnose why it is not generating learning cycles or opportunities.
recommendations.rationale: AI inactivity could mean missing out on market opportunities and failing to adapt to changing conditions, impacting trading performance.

recommendations.action: Assess the trading system's operational status and strategy configurations to ensure they are functioning as intended.
recommendations.rationale: A non-functional trading system means no trades are being executed, directly affecting profitability and platform reliability.
